summary: Full correctness/architecture release: signal migration of the base classes, error-path overhaul, session-lifecycle fixes, timezone-correct timestamps, working 2FA QR. Downstream apps MUST complete every 'breaking' action and review every 'behavioral' entry before pushing to test or prod.

changes.before: BaseView/BaseForm/table components exposed plain mutable fields: records, displayedColumns, searchTerms, editableRecord, isNew, title, isReadOnlyMode, tabFields, searchColumns, dialogComponent.
changes.after: All of these are signals (or computed). Read with call syntax — records(), editableRecord(), isNew() — and write with .set()/.update(). Manual ChangeDetectorRef.markForCheck() calls are unnecessary and removed.
changes.action: In subclasses (e.g. seo RemediationReview extends TableList, daxoom BusinessChild extends TableDetail) replace field reads/writes with signal calls; delete any markForCheck() calls tied to these fields.

changes.before: BaseView carried abstract handleDelete/handleUpdate plus the dialog opener; read-only views had to stub them.
changes.after: BaseView is the read-only listing surface (no abstract members); editing views extend the new AbstractEditableView which owns dialogComponent, addRecord/editRecord/deleteRecord and the abstract handlers.
changes.action: Subclasses that implement handleDelete/handleUpdate now extend AbstractEditableView instead of BaseView. Read-only subclasses extend BaseView and delete their no-op stubs.

changes.before: Templates bound [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyBound" and handlers re-assigned this.isReadOnlyBound = this.isReadOnly.bind(this) to force OnPush refreshes.
changes.after: isReadOnlyBound is gone. Bind [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyFn()" — a computed whose identity changes when readOnlyDeps() signals change. Override protected readOnlyDeps() to register extra signals your isReadOnly() override reads.
changes.action: Replace all isReadOnlyBound bindings and delete rebinding assignments.

changes.before: RecordForm mutated the bound [record] object in place.
changes.after: RecordForm keeps an internal working copy and emits the full updated object via (recordChange); the input object is never mutated.
changes.action: Add (recordChange)="yourRecordSignal.set($event)" (or equivalent) next to every [record] binding whose edits you consume.

changes.before: BaseAuthService.login()/loginWithGoogle() subscribed internally and returned void; errors went to console only.
changes.after: Both return Observable<LoginResponse2FA>. Nothing happens until you subscribe; the error channel carries login failures for the UI.
changes.action: Audit every call site: append .subscribe({ next, error }) and surface errors. A call without subscribe silently does nothing.

changes.before: BackendService.handleError rethrew the string 'error occurred, see console log and try again'.
changes.after: CRUD errors are SailApiError (extends Error) with .status, .problem (keel RFC 7807 ProblemDetail) and .response (original HttpErrorResponse). handleError(error: unknown) is bound-safe for overrides.
changes.action: Error handlers that matched the old string must switch to SailApiError (err instanceof SailApiError; err.status; err.problem?.detail).

changes.before: sail exported IsString/IsNumeric decorators shadowing class-validator names.
changes.after: Renamed IsSailString/IsSailNumeric (constraints IsSailStringConstraint/IsSailNumericConstraint). IsSailNumeric also rejects exponential notation.
changes.action: Rename imports/usages, e.g. daxoom web/src/model/daxdb.ts.

changes.before: <sail-payout-bank-info-form> defaulted provider to 'AW' and countryCode to 'CA'.
changes.after: [provider] is a required input; the country default is the first entry of [countryProfiles]. No hardcoded provider/country can leak into user_bank_info.
changes.action: Pass [provider] explicitly, matching your keel --payout_provider.

changes.before: LabelService.GetLabel/LoadLabels (PascalCase); GetLabel returned '' for missing keys.
changes.after: getLabel/loadLabels; getLabel falls back to the key so missing translations are visible.
changes.action: Rename call sites (trvoo imports LabelService).

changes.before: provider_onboarding, bank_info_form and user_payment_methods shipped styles: blocks (user_payment_methods leaked CSS globally via ViewEncapsulation.None).
changes.after: No CSS ships, matching the rest of the library. Class names are unchanged.
changes.action: Style the .payout-onboarding__*, .bank-info-form*, .user-payment-methods__* classes in the app's global stylesheet if you relied on the shipped look.

changes.before: TableReport extended BaseRestService and fetched via a hardcoded '/api/' prefix.
changes.after: TableReport injects BackendService and uses its new report() method (honours RestURL.api_prefix and typed errors). Report state resets when apiName changes.
changes.action: Only affects subclasses of TableReport relying on BaseRestService members.

changes.before: BaseAuthService captured every REST URL in field initializers, so configureRestUrls() in a subclass constructor ran too late — URLs baked in host-less (bdsrest's pattern was broken; daxoom/seo/trvoo worked around it with module-scope main.ts calls).
changes.after: URLs resolve lazily per request. Constructor-time configureRestUrls() is now safe; main.ts calls keep working.
changes.action: bdsrest: this fixes your constructor-only call. trvoo: the redundant constructor call can be removed.

changes.before: logout() kept the appdata cache, permission index, appData$ replay and the authed route tree alive on the login screen.
changes.after: clearSession() drops cache/permissions/roles/loginToken, recreates the appdata streams and restores the pre-login route config. deleteAccount() clears the role too.
changes.action: None, unless app code relied on reading menus/permissions after logout.

changes.before: A failed appdata load hung the app forever: guards never resolved and every BackendService CRUD call blocked silently.
changes.after: getAppData() errors while nothing is cached; guards redirect to /login/local; BaseAuthService.appDataError signal exposes the failure; repeated 401s clear the dead session and land on login?sessionExpired=true. Circuit-open rejections are a 401 with error.code === AUTH_CIRCUIT_OPEN_CODE.
changes.action: Optional: render appDataError in the app shell; handle the sessionExpired query param on the login page.

changes.before: datetime-local fields displayed the UTC wall-clock labeled as local and stamped local input as UTC, shifting stored times by the user's UTC offset on every edit.
changes.after: Display converts UTC ISO to local time; save converts local input back to UTC ISO. Name-suffix ('...Time') temporal guessing removed — only column metadata drives temporal handling.
changes.action: None. Expect displayed datetimes to change by the user's UTC offset relative to 1.1.9 (they are now correct).

changes.before: TableList silently showed the first 100 rows with no paginator and no sorting; stale search filters survived navigating to the bare list URL.
changes.after: Server-side paging (default 25/page, mat-paginator when total exceeds 10) with per-page client-side sorting; bare-URL navigation clears filters; fetch/save/delete errors render in the view.
changes.action: None; style .table-list__error and the paginator if desired.

changes.before: DisplayMode 'H'/'S' columns still rendered in lists, child grids and search/lookup forms; per-table hiddenFields leaked into search URLs; column defaults became implicit search filters.
changes.after: H/S filtered everywhere; buildSearchTerms honours tableOverrides.hiddenFields; search forms blank every seeded default.
changes.action: None. If a column vanished from a screen, its column_display_attribute says it should never have been there.

changes.before: The 2FA setup QR never rendered (keel returns an otpauth:// URI; it was bound to ).
changes.after: The URI is encoded client-side via the new 'qrcode' dependency (ships with sail). New [twoFactorEnabled] input on <sail-twofactor-setup> routes returning users to the disable form instead of silently rotating their seed.
changes.action: npm install will pull qrcode automatically. Pass [twoFactorEnabled] where the app knows the user's 2FA state.

changes.before: Any same-host response containing a 'data' key was unwrapped; any URL under the backend host was intercepted.
changes.after: Unwrapping requires keel's {data, meta} envelope shape and only /api/ + /public/ paths are in scope (trailing-slash hosts normalized).
changes.action: None.

changes.before: daxoom (6 sites: service/auth.service.ts:46, register-wizard.component.ts:137/157/193, step-claim-verify.component.ts:103, step-manual-verify.component.ts:164) and trvoo (service/auth.service.ts:58, service/tracking.service.ts:28) write localStorage['jwt'] directly.
changes.after: BaseAuthService.acceptToken(token) is the supported entry point (stores the token, resets the auth circuit, loads appdata, runs the OAuth return handoff).
changes.action: Replace raw localStorage writes with acceptToken().

changes.before: bdsrest pins sail 1.1.3 and maintains a local report surface (component/report/report_search.ts, report_list.ts, report_utils.ts, service/report_service.ts, ApplicationData extension in model/appdata.ts with a wrong array-shaped Reports type).
changes.after: sail 1.1.10 covers all of it: TableReport, BaseAuthService.getReports()/getReport(), auto-mounted report routes, and a correctly typed Reports map on ApplicationData.
changes.action: Upgrade to 1.1.10, delete the local report tree and model extensions, and remove the configureRestUrls workaround notes.

changes.before: trvoo carries 11 pure re-export shims (component/abstract/*, component/form/*, component/table/*, service/rest_service.ts, service/label.service.ts, service/auth.interceptor.ts), a near-fork of sail Navigation, and self-declared missing endpoints (forgot/reset password, verify email, refresh, logout) in service/rest_url.ts.
changes.after: Shims add nothing; the endpoint set is a candidate to upstream into sail's RestURL/BaseAuthService in a future release.
changes.action: Delete the shims and import from @nauticana/sail directly. Keep the endpoint list on your radar for upstreaming. Also verify TS ^6 compiles sail's shipped source (sail typechecks on ~5.9).

changes.before: RestURL.payout*URL and paymentMethodSetDefaultURL default to '/api/v1/...'.
changes.after: Unchanged — payout routes are not in the Apis dictionary, so the version cannot be derived at runtime.
changes.action: Apps mounting keel's payout handler under a different prefix must override these via configureRestUrls.
